purpose.internal/agent: Agent runtime supervision, prompt construction, provider CLI execution, leases, heartbeats, claiming, and role strategies.
purpose.internal/alerts: Structured alert parsing, keying, and persistence for orchestration anomalies.
purpose.internal/analysis: Pattern detection and reporting over anomalies in the shared state.
purpose.internal/codexconfig: Codex workspace filesystem permission rendering and provider launch configuration helpers.
purpose.internal/commands: User-facing command handlers that validate CLI input and delegate lifecycle operations.
purpose.internal/db: Blackboard state access layer with locking, watchers, metrics, and model persistence.
purpose.internal/envgate: Environment-flag parsing helper for consistent truthy feature gates across commands and ops.
purpose.internal/errors: Typed errors, exit codes, and safe user-facing error classification.
purpose.internal/filelock: Cross-process file locking and lock metrics for serialized state/log access.
purpose.internal/git: Git repository, merge, rebase, branch, commit, and worktree operations.
purpose.internal/gitenv: Controlled git command execution with consistent environment and timeout behavior.
purpose.internal/identity: Agent ID parsing, validation, role extraction, and next-ID allocation.
purpose.internal/initcheck: Initialization preflight checks for committed clean specs and project readiness.
purpose.internal/integration: End-to-end and concurrent workflow tests for sprint, review, lease, and merge flows.
purpose.internal/interactive: TTY detection, init wizard prompts, and post-init interactive summaries.
purpose.internal/jsonout: JSON envelope output and error serialization for CLI commands.
purpose.internal/log: Append-only runtime log storage, validation, reading, and timestamp tracking.
purpose.internal/models: Core state, task, agent, sprint, config, diagnostics, lease, and history data models.
purpose.internal/ops: Authoritative business operations for tasks, agents, reviews, merges, worktrees, indexing, and blackboard mutations.
purpose.internal/pairingindex: Pairing-mode index activation plumbing that installs managed Git hooks and liza-index scripts for Stacklit and SCIP refresh.
purpose.internal/paths: Canonical construction of project, state, worktree, archive, prompt, output, and alert paths.
purpose.internal/pipeline: Pipeline role configuration, role-pair states, transitions, review policies, and timeout resolution.
purpose.internal/precommit: Pre-commit bootstrap detection and touched-file hook execution planning.
purpose.internal/process: Detached agent process spawning, process attributes, and runtime registration helpers.
purpose.internal/procscan: Process table scanning for zombie or matching Liza agent processes.
purpose.internal/projectdetect: Project toolchain and package-manager detection for setup and optional post-worktree commands.
purpose.internal/prompts: Base prompt, role context, wake prompt, dashboard, and truncation rendering for agents.
purpose.internal/render: Reusable formatting helpers for templates, tables, durations, JSON, YAML, and values.
purpose.internal/roles: Canonical role names, claim modes, and role metadata constants.
purpose.internal/scipsearch: Optional SCIP index planning, generation, discovery, and runtime gating.
purpose.internal/secretmask: Secret-key detection and redaction for logs, prompts, streams, and command output.
purpose.internal/semble: Optional Semble semantic search integration for agent context and repository discovery guidance.
purpose.internal/stacklit: Optional Stacklit repository map index planning, refresh, discovery, and runtime gating.
purpose.internal/statehygiene: State scrubbing and hygiene validation for stale or oversized runtime records.
purpose.internal/statevalidate: Blackboard schema, artifact reference, role, dependency, sprint, and pipeline invariant validation.
purpose.internal/taskkind: Shared task-kind constants used by models and pre-commit bootstrap logic.
purpose.internal/testguard: Repository tests that enforce test-suite guardrails such as sleep and parallel usage rules.
purpose.internal/testhelpers: Shared fixtures, assertions, git setup, pipeline setup, and valid-state builders for tests.
purpose.internal/toolchain: Optional local toolchain catalog, install, configure, doctor, and runner support for Liza development environments.
purpose.internal/tui: Terminal UI model, views, keymaps, commands, styles, and state/log/alert updates.
purpose.internal/worktreeexclude: Private ignore setup for linked worktrees so generated runtime artifacts stay out of Git status.
purpose.plugin/acp: Independent ACP session and run-metrics package for warm-session tracking, ACP-style event aggregation, and warm-vs-fresh benchmark summaries.
purpose.root: Repository-level installation, upgrade, embedded assets, docs, specs, and build configuration.
purpose.scripts/repro: Shell reproducers for operational debugging scenarios such as pre-commit bootstrap flows.
purpose.skills/adversarial-pairing/scripts: Skill-local Python tooling for locked Markdown blackboard writes in adversarial-pairing workflows.
purpose.skills/context-engineering/scripts: Python tooling for indexing prompt, output, and context corpora for context-engineering analysis.
purpose.skills/liza-logs/scripts: Python tooling for analyzing and querying Liza logs and blackboard state dumps.
purpose.skills/spec-backfill/scripts: Shell tooling for detecting stale specs and updating spec-to-code mappings.

architecture.ai_summary:
Liza is a Go CLI orchestration system centered on a file-backed blackboard state. cmd/liza builds the executable and dispatches into internal/commands, while internal/ops owns most state-changing business behavior for tasks, agents, reviews, worktrees, merges, alerts, and optional indexing. internal/models defines the shared domain objects, internal/db serializes state access through file locks, and internal/statevalidate enforces schema, artifact, role, dependency, sprint, and workflow invariants.

Agent execution is organized around configurable role pipelines. internal/pipeline defines roles, role pairs, task statuses, transitions, review policies, context sections, and timeouts; internal/agent claims work, builds prompts via internal/prompts, runs configured providers, manages leases and heartbeats, masks secrets, and invokes git, pre-commit, SCIP, Semble, and Stacklit support when enabled. Data flows from CLI or TUI input into commands, then ops, then db-backed model updates, with log, alert, validation, and prompt-rendering packages feeding operator views and subsequent agent context.

Infrastructure concerns are kept in small packages: git/gitenv for repository operations, paths for canonical artifact locations, process/procscan for agent lifecycle, render/jsonout/log for output surfaces, secretmask for safe text handling, and pairingindex/scipsearch/stacklit/semble for optional repository indexing. Tests are broad across commands, ops, pipeline, state validation, and integration workflows, so feature work should follow existing package boundaries and validate the full orchestration path rather than only local helpers.
